steps.text: Talk to Kaqemeex in the stone circle north of Taverley.
chat: 2. I'm in search of a quest.
1. Okay, I will try and help.

steps.text: Talk to Sanfew, who is upstairs in the Herb shop in Taverley.
chat: 1. I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.

steps.text: Bring the four meats to the Cauldron in Taverley Dungeon, and use them on the Cauldron to enchant them.
